source: R package drc, data set S.alba ('Potency of two herbicides'): dry matter (g/pot) of white mustard (Sinapis alba) after glyphosate or bentazone at doses in g/ha; 68 observations. Christensen MG, Teicher HB, Streibig JC (2003) Linking fluorescence induction curve and biomass in herbicide screening. Pest Manag Sci 59:1303-1310. Values copied from the Rdatasets CSV of drc's S.alba (vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/csv/drc/S.alba.csv), in its row order.

published_fit.source: drc 3.4.0 reference page for S.alba, example summary(S.alba.LL.4.1): drm(DryMatter ~ Dose, Herbicide, data = S.alba, fct = LL.4(), pmodels = data.frame(Herbicide, 1, 1, Herbicide)), i.e. common lower and upper limits, separate slopes and ED50s
